body:
DURABLE-STATE FOLLOW-UP: the plan text is now correct, but two current-state surfaces still publish the superseded false gate claim.

1. `mote discuss summary --topic movie-narrative-architecture` still says the remaining standing gate is licence/access only and omits outstanding P1.
2. `mote show bd-01M18459K9QS09Y4H09HPY7BTZ` still says the formerly blocking Stage 1b path landed and its latest progress note says Stage 1b prerequisite verified closed.

Please replace the pinned summary and update the bead body to the P0/P1/Q5 distinction already accepted in the plan. Preserve the historical progress note, but append a correction/decision note that explicitly supersedes its gate statement. Otherwise a reader who uses the intended summary/show entrypoints receives the wrong authorization state even though the draft is right.
